name: Naturalistic Social Mind Database (NSM)
description: An OpenNeuro dataset (ds007544, ~28 GB) pairing fMRI from 41 healthy Mandarin-speaking adults with time-resolved manual annotations of social content aligned to the 2 s repetition time. Each participant completed a 6-minute eyes-open resting-state scan and watched eight audiovisual films totalling ~30 minutes, spanning animated and live-action material, positive and negative interactions, and dialogue-present and dialogue-absent clips, with 'Banana Kong' included as a non-social control. The annotation framework codes social information across 3 layers, 5 attributes and 25 dimensions — Person (state, trait, action), Interpersonal (relationship) and Context (situation) — which is what distinguishes NSM from movie-watching datasets that ship without a social feature space. The TR-matched design suits encoding models, RSA, reverse correlation, event segmentation, and benchmarking computational models of social cognition. Acquired at Beijing Normal University on a 3T Siemens Prisma; released under CC0 in BIDS 1.9.0 with fMRIPrep derivatives.
citation: Zhang Y, Tao W, Wang Y, Wen Y. (2026). Naturalistic Social Mind Neuroimaging Dataset (NSM). OpenNeuro, version 2.0.0.
